name: SVC_MCA_ENTITY_CRITERIA
description: This table is used to create query criteria for the VO entity being used by the LOOKUPS or ENTITY_ACTION

columns.name: ENTITY_CRITERIA_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: FIELD_NAME
columns.description: The name of the field in the VO Object being used in the query criteria.

columns.name: ENTITY_ACTION_OR_LOOKUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to either the SVC_MCA_ENTITY_ACTION.ENTITY_ACTION_ID or SVC_MCA_LOOKUPS.LOOKUP_ID

columns.name: CRITERIA_ORDER
columns.description: Specifies the order in a set of where clause specification

columns.name: IS_GROUP_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies if the row is for a group of attributes

columns.name: OPERATOR
columns.description: Specifies the operation (equals, not equals, between, like, greater than, less than, greater or equal, less or equal).  Foreign Key to the ORA_SVC_MCA_CRIT_OPERATOR_CD lookup

columns.name: VALUE_START
columns.description: Specifies token / custom attribute which gives the value

columns.name: VALUE_END
columns.description: Specifies token / custom attribute which gives the value

columns.name: LOGICAL_OPERATOR
columns.description: Specifies the logical relation of the row to the following of the same category (attribute or group) – values: AND / OR.  Foreign key to the ORA_SVC_MCA_LOGIC_OPERATOR_CD

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the category is logically deleted (Y or N).
